HOW THIS VERSION WORKS

Clear reasons, better decisions.

01

Prerequisites first

Topics become available once their prerequisite topics are marked confident.

02

Measure across time

Alternate questions check understanding before study, immediately after, and again the next day.

03

You stay in control

Recommendations consider your goal and available time. Cognitive task results remain separate from topic recommendations.

Research note: the questions and cognitive tasks are not calibrated, and this version does not predict learning gain or diagnose cognitive traits.
